content: Route the deployment logs to security so devops can patch the server vulnerabilities.
notes: Tests the explicit subject guard on 'conj' chains. 'patch' belongs to devops, not the user.

content: By the way, if you have a moment, please compile the quarterly performance report.
notes: Tests text extraction resilience when wrapped inside introductory parenthetical chatter.

content: Please verify the database backups so that the engineering lead can sign off on the release.
notes: Classic purpose clause validation. Ensure 'sign' does not leak or borrow user assignment context.

content: Draft the architectural blueprint, by the way, the client wants to see it by tomorrow morning.
